svg.title: Антиротационный жим Паллофа — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Standing anti-rotation Pallof press. Athlete faces toward the camera at slight oblique angle, while cable machine is distinctly to the athlete's side, not in front. A single taut cable from the chest-height pulley off to his left connects to ONE small D handle grasped in both hands together. LEFT both hands hold handle directly at sternum with bent elbows. RIGHT arms extend straight FORWARD away from sternum in the direction the nose and chest face, handle remains directly in front of center chest and cable pulls horizontally sideways. Hips and shoulders stay square and feet and torso unchanged, no twisting. Single tower and one connected side cable in each panel. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
